resources.string: Ayikho i-Apple Watch ebhangqwe nale iPhone.
I-Phase Wake ewashini
Faka i-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho ku-app ye-Watch.
Ama-alamu avunyelwe
Vumela i-Phase Wake ukuthi isethe ama-alamu ukuze i-iPhone yakho ikwazi ukukhala njenge-alamu yokwesekwa.
Qala imodi yetafula lasembhedeni
Ukuze uthole ukuphuma kwelanga, shiya i-Phase Wake ivuliwe kushaja ubusuku bonke. Isikrini sihlala simnyama kuze kuqale ukukhanya.
Kuhlala kuvuliwe ubusuku bonke – faka i-iPhone yakho kushaja.
Konke kuhlala efonini nasewashini lakho. Ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho iseva, akukho ukulandelwa.
Qeda
Ukuphuma kwelanga ngo-%1$s
Ayikho i-alamu enokuphuma kwelanga
I-iPhone yakho ingakhombisa ukukhanya kuphela lapho i-Phase Wake ivuliwe – qala imodi yetafula lasembhedeni ngaphambi kokulala.
Ubude bokulala nokuvama kuvela ku-Apple Health.
Vula i-Phase Wake ngaphambi kokulala ukuze iwashi lakho likwazi ukulungisa i-alamu.
I-alamu ilungisiwe ewashini
Vula i-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho ngaphambi kokulala. I-watchOS ilungisa i-alamu kuphela lapho i-app ivuliwe.
Apple Watch: i-alamu ayivuliwe – isaziso kuphela, azikho izigaba zokulala. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza lwewashi.
Thepha ukuze uvule i-alamu yakho yanamuhla ebusuku.
Imizuzu engu-%1$d yokuqala ayilinganiswanga – i-Apple Watch ilinganisa kuphela imizuzu engu-%2$d yokugcina ngaphambi kwesikhathi esihlosiwe.

Apple Health
Ubusuku obuvela ku-Apple Health nakwamanye ama-app nabo bungavela lapha. Ukuze ububone, qhathanisa nedatha yezempilo.
Ayikho idatha yokulala evela ku-Apple Health okwamanje. Ukulala kufanele kurekhodwe lapho, isibonelo nge-Apple Watch yakho, futhi i-Phase Wake kufanele ivunyelwe ukukufunda ku-app ye-Health.
Ubusuku obuvela kwamanye ama-app (isb. i-Apple Health) abulondolozwa – buhlala lapho futhi buvele futhi uma sekunikezwe imvume.

I-Phase Wake ingafunda idatha yokulala egcinwa yi-app yakho yezempilo (isibonelo i-Apple Health). Iboniswa emlandweni wakho, futhi ukuze iqhathaniswe nobusuku i-Phase Wake ekuvuse ngabo. I-Phase Wake iyafunda kuphela, ayibhali neze, futhi akukho okuphuma efonini yakho.
Izaziso ewashini
Vumela izaziso ezibucayi ngesikhathi ze-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho. Uma kungenjalo, ayikwazi ukukuvusa ngesaziso uma kungekho kukala okuqhubekayo.

Iwashi lakho alizange liqale ukulinganisa ngaphambi kokulala – i-Phase Wake ayivunyelwe ukufunda idatha yokunyakaza kulo. Kuvumele kumasethingi ewashi ngaphansi kokuthi Ubumfihlo. I-alamu isazokuvusa.
Isimo sewashi asisesikhathini – vula i-Phase Wake kafushane ewashini.

Kubalwa kusukela lapho uzumeka – thepha u-“Ulale kahle” ewashini lakho lapho uyolala. Ku-Apple Watch, i-Phase Wake ilinganisela ukuthi uzumeka nini ngesikhathi sokuzumeka esiyifundile. Ngaphandle kokuthepha, kusebenza isikhathi esisethiwe.

Vula i-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho kusukela ehoreni elingu-1 ngaphambi kokulala (iwashi liyakukhumbuza), bese liqopha ukunyakaza kwakho kusukela lapho kuze kube sewindini lokuvuka; bese i-Phase Wake ibala ukuthi uzumeke nini.
